note: Default planning assumptions only. They have not been validated against ELA's admissions policy. Administrators may edit the numbers; no lesson text depends on them.
assumptions: Age is measured on the first day of Term 1.
NERDC lists a One-Year Pre-Primary Education Curriculum for Age 5, so Reception is assumed to serve children who turn 5 during or just before the year (to be confirmed against the document).
Children develop at different rates. Placement follows ELA admissions policy and teacher judgement, not age alone.
